title: AI Language Models Could Both Help and Harm Equity in Marine Policymaking: The Case Study of the BBNJ Question-Answering Bot

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative analysis of a marine policy question-answering bot's outputs to assess if it disproportionately favors the viewpoints, positions, and official narratives of developed Western nations while ignoring or omitting the perspectives of developing nations.

Qualitative evaluation of the chatbot's responses regarding access and benefit-sharing mechanisms to determine if it adequately reflects the systemic inequalities, resource constraints, and capacity imbalances faced by under-resourced states.

Analyzing the chatbot's interpretation of polite UN diplomatic decorum and its responses to varying prompt tones (e.g., soft vs. confrontational), demonstrating how it defaults to dominant institutional narratives rather than recognizing the veiled grievances of marginalized actors.
